name: image-studio
description: Create, enhance, edit, inspect, repair, and verify images with AI upscaling, numbered maps, reference mixing, bounded review loops, and pixel audits that prove the change is visible and the rest untouched.

interface.shortDescription: Create, repair, and verify images with evidence.
interface.longDescription: Ten image skills: inspection, whole-image enhancement (upscaling, cleanup, cutouts, web export), numbered edit maps, reverse engineering, reference mixing, reconstruction, creation, local repair, bounded create-review-repair loops, and source-pixel verification. Image generation stays with the host's image tool.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this image, make the named change, and verify protected details.
